howToDescription: Six guided steps to complete your student TIE residency card process in Barcelona.

faqs.question: Do TIE photos need specific specs?
faqs.answer: Yes — passport format with white background.

empadronamiento.title: Register Your Address
empadronamiento.short: Register your address at the local Ayuntamiento (empadronamiento).
empadronamiento.description: Empadronamiento is the official registration of your residence address in Barcelona's municipal register. It proves that you live in a specific neighbourhood and is required for many formalities — including your TIE appointment.
empadronamiento.whyItExists: The Spanish system uses empadronamiento to prove residence for administrative procedures like healthcare, school, and immigration formalities.
empadronamiento.completionPrompt: Did you receive your empadronamiento certificate at the Ayuntamiento?

toma-de-huellas.title: Book Your Fingerprint Appointment
toma-de-huellas.short: Reserve an online appointment to submit your TIE application and have fingerprints taken.
toma-de-huellas.description: Before you apply for your TIE, you must book a "cita previa" on the official Spanish government site. This appointment is when you'll submit your documents and have your fingerprints captured. Demand is high in Barcelona so appointments often get fully booked quickly, especially in peak months (like September).
toma-de-huellas.whyItExists: The Spanish police require in-person verification and fingerprints for identity cards. Appointments ensure orderly processing and verification.
toma-de-huellas.completionPrompt: Do you have your Cita Previa appointment confirmation saved or printed?

appointment-confirmation.description: Print or save the confirmation to bring to the police station.

required-documents.title: Prepare the Required Documents
required-documents.short: Gather and organise all the paperwork you need before your appointment.
required-documents.description: Bring all required documents printed and organised. This prevents rejections at your appointment — missing even one piece often means you have to reschedule and wait longer.
required-documents.whyItExists: Spanish bureaucracy is strict about completeness and accuracy — official forms, passport copies, fee payments, and certificates must be exact.
required-documents.completionPrompt: Do you have all required documents printed and organised for your appointment?

estimatedTime.label: Prep Time
estimatedTime.value: 1–3 days to collect and make copies

commonQuestions.question: Do photos need specific specs?
commonQuestions.answer: Yes — passport format with white background

commonQuestions.question: Can I pay the fee later?
commonQuestions.answer: No — you must pay the 790-012 fee and bring proof of payment at appointment

commonQuestions.question: Can documents be in English?
commonQuestions.answer: Most have to be translated if not in Spanish — check country of origin rules

valid-passport.label: Valid passport
valid-passport.description: Original plus photocopies of main page and visa/entry stamp.

student-visa.label: Student visa or residence authorisation
student-visa.description: Proof of permission to stay longer than 6 months.

passport-photos.label: Passport-style photographs
passport-photos.description: Recent color photos with white background.

appointment-confirmation-doc.label: Appointment confirmation
appointment-confirmation-doc.description: Printed confirmation from the Cita Previa website.

pay-fee.title: Pay the TIE Issuance Fee
pay-fee.short: Complete and pay the official Modelo 790 code 012 fee before your appointment.
pay-fee.description: You must fill in the official Modelo 790 fee form (code 012) and pay it at a Spanish bank before your TIE appointment. You'll need to bring proof of payment with you — without it they can reject the application on the spot.
pay-fee.whyItExists: The fee is a legal requirement for processing and manufacturing your TIE card. Paying before the appointment confirms your commitment and covers administrative costs.
pay-fee.completionPrompt: Did you pay the Modelo 790 fee and receive your payment receipt?

cta.start: I'm going to pay the fee

estimatedTime.label: Bank Visit
estimatedTime.value: 30 minutes to 1 hour at a bank branch

estimatedTime.label: Processing
estimatedTime.value: Immediate issue of a payment receipt

commonQuestions.question: Can I pay online?
commonQuestions.answer: Usually at a bank for code 012 — check if online bank allows this

commonQuestions.question: Do I need the exact code?
commonQuestions.answer: Yes — use code 012 specifically for TIE issuance

fee-payment-receipt.label: Fee payment receipt
fee-payment-receipt.description: Receipt provided by the bank after payment — must be brought to appointment.

fingerprint-appointment.title: Attend Your Fingerprint Appointment
fingerprint-appointment.short: Go to your scheduled appointment with all documents — fingerprints are taken and application is submitted.
fingerprint-appointment.description: At the police station on your appointment day you will submit all documents, have your fingerprints and photo taken, and receive a appointment receipt (resguardo). This confirms your application and tells you when and where to pick up your TIE.
fingerprint-appointment.whyItExists: This in-person step verifies your identity (biometrics) and ensures all information on your card is accurate and linked to your fingerprints.
fingerprint-appointment.completionPrompt: Did you attend your appointment and receive your resguardo (receipt)?

commonQuestions.question: What if I forget a document?
commonQuestions.answer: They may cancel your appointment — you'll have to rebook

commonQuestions.question: Do they issue the TIE on the spot?

documents-from-step-3.label: All required documents prepared in Step 3

collect-tie.title: Pick Up Your TIE
collect-tie.short: Return to the police station after processing to collect your physical TIE card.
collect-tie.description: Once your TIE is ready (often ~30–45 days after your appointment), you return with your receipt to collect your physical card. In some cases you may need to schedule an appointment for pickup.
collect-tie.whyItExists: The TIE card is produced centrally and not printed on site. The wait time is part of the card manufacturing and delivery process.
collect-tie.completionPrompt: Did you collect your physical TIE card?
